nphi.title: MPX-RESPONSE – Clinical research network to improve the management of mpox
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Folkehelseinstituttet); Fundación Huésped; Oslo University Hospital; ECRAID; UMC Utrecht; Erasmus MC; University of Antwerp; University of Verona; APHP; PANDEMIC platform

nphi.title: Fiocruz – Erasmus MC and EATRIS MoUs
nphi.with: Erasmus University Medical Center; EATRIS
nphi.summary: International cooperation MoUs between Fiocruz and Erasmus MC (2020-2025) and the European translational medicine infrastructure EATRIS (2020-2023).

nphi.title: ZikaPLAN – Zika Preparedness Latin American Network
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Instituto de Medicina Tropical Pedro Kourí (IPK); Institut Pasteur; Institut Pasteur de Dakar; Instituto Butantan; LSHTM; Erasmus MC; ITM Antwerp; Universidad del Valle; Swiss TPH

nphi.title: ZIKAlliance – A global alliance for Zika virus control and prevention
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP Mexico); Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Folkehelseinstituttet); Institut Pasteur; Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social; Universidad Industrial de Santander; Institut Louis Malardé (French Polynesia); Bernhard-Nocht-Institut

nphi.title: SCAPHeR – Applied public health research capacity in GHPP regions (GHPP)
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Social Services Namibia; Jordan Center for Disease Control (JCDC); Fiocruz

nphi.title: CELESTA 2.0 – Genomic surveillance of outbreak-prone viral diseases

nphi.title: Brazil–Africa CDC South-South cooperation on field epidemiology training (EpiSUS model)
nphi.actor: Brazilian Ministry of Health – Department of Public Health Emergencies (EpiSUS)
nphi.with: Africa CDC (Addis Ababa); PAHO; Portuguese-speaking African countries
nphi.summary: Initiative launched in 2026 by Brazil's health ministry with PAHO and Africa CDC to adapt the tiered EpiSUS field epidemiology programme, tutor training and Moodle-based digital learning for Africa CDC member states' emergency workforce.

nphi.title: Fiocruz–Institut Pasteur–Sanofi strategic alliance for vaccine development

nphi.title: ISCIII–Fiocruz memorandum of understanding

nphi.title: Bio-Manguinhos–ANLIS yellow fever vaccine technology transfer

nphi.title: RKI – Fiocruz cooperation memorandum

nphi.title: ReLAVRA+ – Latin American and Caribbean Network for Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance (Malbrán as regional reference)

nphi.title: BRICS TB Research Network meetings
nphi.with: BRICS TB research network partners

nphi.title: Pasteur Network (Institut Pasteur International Network)

nphi.title: IANPHI 2025 annual meeting session on climate change and disease

nphi.title: Ecuador–Fiocruz technical cooperation on leptospirosis and arboviruses

nphi.summary: In June 2025 an Ecuadorian health ministry delegation visited IOC/Fiocruz's national leptospirosis reference laboratory and regional arbovirus reference laboratory to define areas of technical cooperation and joint prevention and control…

nphi.title: First Conference of G20 National Public Health Institutes (Rio de Janeiro, 2024)

nphi.with: IANPHI; Africa CDC
nphi.summary: At a G20-linked NPHI conference in Rio, IANPHI, Fiocruz and Africa CDC called on G20 ministers to strengthen NPHI mandates for all-hazards surveillance, preparedness, local production of countermeasures and the IANPHI climate roadmap.

nphi.title: France–Brazil arbovirus cooperation workshop (IEC–ANRS MIE)

nphi.title: Fiocruz – Inserm cooperation agreement

nphi.title: Fiocruz – Institut Pasteur cooperation agreements

nphi.summary: Cooperation agreement (2015, within the International Network of Pasteur Institutes) and basic agreement (2018) between Fiocruz and Institut Pasteur for joint scientific research.

nphi.title: Fiocruz – LSHTM memorandum of understanding

nphi.summary: Cooperation MoU between Fiocruz and the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine.
